title: Self-Generated Chiral Rotation in Whispering-Gallery Optomechanics
summary: Backscattering in whispering-gallery-mode resonators is usually a passive mode-splitting mechanism produced by a fixed defect. Here, we show that, when the backscatterer is a mechanical angular degree of freedom, the same process becomes an angular-recoil backaction channel capable of generating chirality under reciprocal driving. A localized movable scatterer coherently converts photons between clockwise and counterclockwise whispering-gallery modes, transferring angular recoil in each circulation-changing event.
